kashika: तेनेति तृतीयासमर्थात् संस्कृतमित्येतस्मिन्नर्थे ठक् प्रत्ययो भवति। सत उत्कर्षाधानं संस्कारः। दध्ना संस्कृतं दाधिकम्। शार्ङ्गवेरिकम्। मारिचिकम्। योगविभाग उत्तरार्थः॥
kashikaEnglish: ठक् after instrumental for 'refined/prepared thereby': दध्ना संस्कृतं = दाधिकम् 'refined by curd', मारीचिकम्. संस्कृत = quality-enhancement.
englishShort: To express an entity that has been cultured / processed, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय gets attached to the तृतीयासमर्थ word indicating the substance used for culturing / processing.
englishFull:
संस्कृतम् — ठक् comes after an instrumental-case word meaning "refined/enhanced thereby":

| Base | Derivative | Meaning |
|------|------------|---------|
| दधि (curd) | दाधिकम् | refined with curd |
| शृङ्गवेर (ginger) | शार्ङ्गवेरिकम् | flavored with ginger |
| मरीच (pepper) | मारीचिकम् | spiced with pepper |

@note[संस्कृत = enhancing quality. Separate sūtra for next rule's अनुवृत्ति.]
